title: Oven-Roasted Andean Lentil Paella
description: A light and flavorful Peruvian dish featuring Puy lentils, tempered chocolate, and a hint of spice. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon ground cumin
ingredients.notes: use a mild cumin for a more delicate flavor

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomatoes, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine.
Add the rinsed Puy lentils and stir to combine with the tomato mixture.
Transfer the paella pan to the preheated oven and roast for 25-30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the paella pan from the oven and stir in the chopped cilantro and tempered chocolate.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Let the paella rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
